mining.estimatesLater: Estimates appear once the wallet knows the current network difficulty.
mining.expectationsText: LBC is mined mostly by specialised hardware, so a CPU earns only a tiny amount. Mining here supports the network and is great for learning — keep an eye on electricity costs.
mining.soloFullReward: solo mining pays the full reward
mining.decentralizedSoon: A decentralized pool (no operator, like P2Pool) is planned for a later version — see the roadmap.
mining.threadsHint: Leave a core or two free to keep your computer responsive.
mining.lowPriorityHint: Mining yields to anything else you're doing on this computer.
mining.pauseOnBatteryHint: Stops mining when a laptop is unplugged and resumes on AC power.

onlyIdleHint.other: Mines after {count} minutes without keyboard or mouse input and pauses the moment you're back.

mining.subPhone: Mine LBRY Credits with this phone — rewards go straight to your wallet.

mining.pausedBackground: Paused while LBC Wallet is not on the screen
mining.onlyChargingHint: Mining drains a phone's battery fast. If you switch this off, mining still stops when the battery is below {level}.
mining.threadsHintPhone: More threads mine faster but make the phone warmer. Start with half.
mining.phoneText: Mining runs only while LBC Wallet is open on the screen, and the screen stays on meanwhile. It pauses when the battery reaches {temperature}, while battery saver is on and, unless you change it, while the phone is not charging. A phone earns very little and long mining wears the battery: keep it on a charger, out of the sun and out of its case.

badge.verifiedHint: Merkle proof checked against a proof-of-work header

review.title: Review payment

review.irreversible: Double-check the address: LBC transactions cannot be reversed.

explain.other: {count} tip/support outputs will be returned to your spendable balance. This abandons those supports on LBRY (content you tipped loses that boost).

welcome.lead: A non-custodial wallet for LBRY Credits — with mining built in. Your keys never leave this computer.
welcome.leadMobile: A non-custodial wallet for LBRY Credits — with mining built in. Your keys never leave this phone.
welcome.restoreHint: 12/24 words — works with LBRY Desktop, Odysee and BIP39 phrases
welcome.importHint: An xprv from LBRY Desktop, or an xpub for a watch-only wallet
welcome.keysLocal: Keys are encrypted with your password (scrypt + AES-256-GCM) and stored only on this device.

settings.showFiatHint: Fetches the LBC price from CoinPaprika (CoinGecko as fallback). Turn off for maximum privacy.
settings.hideBalancesHint: Mask amounts on screen (useful when sharing your screen).
settings.explorerHint: Link used for “View in explorer”. {txid} is replaced with the transaction id.
settings.modeHubHint: Hubs are public servers that index the LBRY blockchain. They never see your keys, and every confirmed transaction is checked against proof-of-work headers.
settings.modeLocalHint: The wallet runs its own full LBRY node on this computer and uses it as soon as it has downloaded the blockchain. Until then it uses public servers.
settings.modeOwnHint: Maximum privacy and trust: the wallet talks only to your own full node.
settings.builtInOff: The node is switched off. Turn it on from the Node page.
settings.builtInSyncing: The node is downloading the blockchain. Public servers are used until it is ready.
settings.builtInSynced: The node is ready and the wallet uses it.
settings.hubsWhileSyncing: Used until the built-in node is ready, and as a fallback.
settings.defaultHubsHint: Odysee and community-operated hubs. The wallet picks one and fails over automatically.
settings.ownNodeHelp: Run lbcd with {flags} and RPC credentials. The default RPC port is {port} (HTTPS with the self-signed {cert}; point the certificate field at it, or run lbcd with {notls} on localhost).
settings.socksHint: Hub, pool and price connections go through the proxy; DNS is resolved by the proxy too.
settings.autoLockHint: Lock the wallet after this much inactivity. It also locks when the device sleeps.
settings.passwordOnSend: Ask for the password on every send
settings.passwordOnSendHint: Recommended. When on, private keys are never kept in memory — they're derived only to sign, then wiped.
settings.changePasswordHint: Re-encrypts this wallet's keys with a new password.
settings.showPhraseHint: Displays the secret that controls this wallet. Make sure nobody is watching.
settings.showPhrasePrompt: Enter your password to display the recovery phrase.
settings.xpubHint: Lets software watch your balance without being able to spend. It reveals all your addresses — share carefully.
settings.secretWarning: Anyone who sees this can take your funds. Never share it or enter it on a website.
settings.withPassphrase: protected with an extra BIP39 passphrase
settings.openWalletFirst: Open a wallet to manage it.
settings.defaultFeeHint: Dewies per byte. 50 is the LBRY SDK default; the network minimum relay fee is 1.
settings.rescanHint: Re-downloads this wallet's history from the network. Use it if a balance looks wrong.
settings.deleteWalletHint: Removes the wallet file from this device. Your funds stay on the blockchain and can be restored with the recovery phrase.
settings.deleteWarning: Make sure you have your recovery phrase written down.
settings.deleteWarningStrong: Without it, the funds in “{name}” are lost forever.

about.unauditedTitle: Not audited — use at your own risk
about.unauditedText: This is free, community-made software. No independent security audit has been done yet, and it may contain bugs that lose money. Only use amounts you can afford to lose, and always keep your recovery phrase.
about.developerModeHint: Shows test-network options. Wallets are kept separately per network.
about.license: LBC Wallet is open-source software under the MIT license, provided “as is”, without warranty of any kind. It is not affiliated with LBRY Inc., Odysee, or any exchange or pool.

terms.title: Read this before you start
terms.lead: LBC Wallet is free, experimental software made by volunteers. Please read these points — it takes about a minute.

risk.title: You use it at your own risk
risk.text: The software is provided “as is”, without any warranty, under the MIT license. The authors and contributors are not liable for any loss of funds, data, income or hardware, whatever the cause — including bugs, mistakes, hacks, or misuse.

audit.title: It has not been audited
audit.text: No independent security audit has been done yet. It may contain flaws that lose money or leak information. Start with small amounts, keep only what you can afford to lose, and report problems so they can be fixed.

keys.title: Only you control your money
keys.text: This is a non-custodial wallet: your keys are created and kept only on your device. Nobody — not the developers, not LBRY — can see your password, recover a lost recovery phrase, freeze funds, or reverse a payment. Write the recovery phrase on paper and keep it safe and private.

mining.title: Mining costs more than it earns on most computers
mining.text: A normal processor earns very little LBC. Mining uses a lot of electricity, makes your computer hot and loud, and can wear out hardware faster. Pools are run by third parties who may change fees, go offline or not pay. Check that mining is allowed where you live and on the computer you use.

network.title: It connects to the internet
network.text: To show balances and send payments, the wallet talks to public LBRY servers, mining pools, price services, and — if you turn it on — other nodes through the built-in node. Their operators can see your IP address and which addresses you ask about. Use your own node or a proxy such as Tor for more privacy.

law.title: You are responsible for how you use it
law.text: Follow the laws and tax rules of your country. Nothing in this app is financial advice. LBC Wallet is an independent community project and is not affiliated with LBRY Inc., Odysee, or any exchange or pool.

terms.licenseNote: Full text: DISCLAIMER.md and LICENSE (MIT) in the source code and in the installed app folder.
terms.checkAudit: I understand this software is not audited and may contain bugs that lose money.
terms.checkKeys: I understand that I alone am responsible for my recovery phrase and password, and that nobody can recover them for me.
terms.checkRisk: I use LBC Wallet at my own risk. The authors are not responsible for any loss.

node.title: Full node
node.sub: Run your own LBRY node: verify everything yourself, help the network, and mine solo.
node.introTitle: Run a full LBRY node on this computer
node.introText: The node downloads and checks every block of the LBRY blockchain and shares them with other nodes, like the Monero GUI's local node. When it is ready, your wallet stops relying on public servers and you can mine solo. You can keep using the wallet while it downloads.
node.reqTimeHint: depends on your internet and disk
node.lowRam: This computer has {have} GB of memory; the node is happiest with {need} GB. It may run slowly or stop.
node.lowDisk: The selected drive may not have enough free space (about {need} GB needed). Choose a bigger drive below.
node.storageDefault: Inside the app's data folder. Choose a folder on a bigger drive (an external disk works) if this one is short on space.
node.storageCustom: Your chosen folder. Keep the drive connected while the node runs.
node.listenHint: Lets other nodes download blocks from you, which strengthens the network. The app asks your router to open port {port} (UPnP). Uses more upload bandwidth. Takes effect when the node starts.
node.readyText: The wallet now reads the blockchain from your own node, and solo mining can use it.
node.readyNotUsed: The node is in sync. Switch the wallet to it to stop using public servers.
node.syncHint: You can close this page or keep using the wallet; the node keeps syncing in the background while the app is open. Closing the app pauses it, and it continues where it stopped.
node.useForWallet: Use this node for the wallet
node.moveHint: To move the blockchain, stop the node, move the folder, then choose it with “Change…”.
node.about: The node is lbcd, LBRY's official full-node software, bundled unmodified. It only runs while you have it switched on.
node.peersHint: One address per line, as host:port — for example your own node on another computer. Takes effect when the node starts.

supply.title: LBC supply
supply.minedShare: {percent} of all LBC has been created
supply.hint: From LBRY's reward rules, which every node checks: the reward goes down by 1 LBC in steps that get longer over time, until it reaches zero. After that, miners earn transaction fees only. Block 0 created 400,000,000 LBC (LBRY's pre-mine); all other LBC is paid to miners.
